system.lightMode.note: Yana amfani da fuskar Windows mai haske; ana ba da shawara don tawadar lantarki.
system.lightMode.unavailable: Yana buƙatar Windows 10 May 2019 Update ko sabuwa.
saturation.unavailable: Yana buƙatar Windows 11 24H2 ko sabuwa da allo mai tallafin ACM.
saturation.unsupported.upgrade: Wannan allo ba ya tallafa wa daidaita ƙarfin launi ta E-Ink Assistant. Windows 11 24H2 ko sabuwa na iya ƙara tallafi; in ba haka ba, daidaita shi a kwamitin sarrafa GPU.
saturation.unsupported.driver: Wannan allo ba ya tallafa wa daidaita ƙarfin launi ta E-Ink Assistant da GPU ko direban yanzu. Gwada sabunta direban zane ko daidaita shi a kwamitin sarrafa GPU.
saturation.manual: Masu sarrafa Ƙarfin launi da RGB a kashe suke. Haka kuma za ka iya daidaita su da hannu a kwamitin sarrafa GPU.
saturation.unsupported.clone: Windows ba zai iya amfani da Ƙarfin launi ko RGB a yanayin Kwafi ba. Sauya zuwa Faɗaɗa don amfani da waɗannan masu sarrafawa.
display.cloneWarning: Yanayin Kwafi yana aiki. Sauran daidaitawar allo suna shafar: %1 ma.
saturation.experimental.enable: Kunna masu sarrafa Ƙarfin launi da RGB (na gwaji)
saturation.experimental.preparing: Gwajin zai fara cikin daƙiƙa %1. Idan allon bai yi daidai ba, za a mayar da canje-canje ta atomatik.
saturation.experimental.confirm: Duba allon. Idan ba ka tabbatar ba, za a mayar da canje-canje ta atomatik cikin daƙiƙa %1.
saturation.experimental.dialog.preparing: Za a yi ɗan canjin ƙarfin launi. Lura da duhun da bai dace ba, sauyin launi, ko rashin iya ganin allo.
saturation.experimental.dialog.confirm.t: Allon yana kama da yadda ya kamata?
saturation.experimental.dialog.confirm.b: Tabbatar kawai idan babu duhun da bai dace ba, sauyin launi, ko rashin iya gani. In ba haka ba, mayar da canje-canje; za a kuma maido da su ta atomatik.
saturation.acm: Yana amfani da Sarrafa Launi ta Atomatik na Windows. Ana maido da shi idan an fita daga manhajar.
shaking.unavailable: Babu amintaccen mai sarrafa haɗa launi da ɗigon pixels na jama'a ga kowane allo don wannan GPU a Windows.
night.title: Hasken dare
night.note: Windows yana sarrafa Hasken dare ga dukan tsarin maimakon ga kowane allo.
night.fallback.recommendation: Muna ba da shawarar kashe Hasken dare ga allunan tawadar lantarki.
night.disable.title: Kashe Hasken dare
night.disable.note: Hasken dare yana ƙara launi mai ɗumi; kashe shi don tawadar lantarki.
night.disable.warning: Ga allunan tawadar lantarki, muna ba da shawarar kashe Hasken dare.
help.windows: Ƙarfin launi da RGB suna amfani da Sarrafa Launi ta Atomatik a Windows 11 24H2 ko sabuwa, ko hanyar bayanin launi MHC2 a ginin Windows 10 na 19041–19045. Bambancin hasken rubutu, Inganta bidiyo da Na ci gaba suna amfani da teburin gamma ga kowane allo. Ana maido da duk daidaitawar allo lokacin fita daga manhajar kuma a sake amfani da su lokacin buɗewa.
welcome.windows.tray: Buɗe menu na ɓoyayyun alamomi a dama na sandar aiki, nemo wannan alamar shafukan littafi, sannan ja ta zuwa wurin da ake iya gani.
welcome.windows.tray.title: Tsayar da alamar tiren tsarin
